events.factual_description: Rhizome DC and Secret Planet present Peni Candra Rini with Shahzad Ismaily and Andy McGraw, with Alex Koi x Kirin McElwain opening, on Saturday, October 24, 2026. Doors are at 18:30 and the show begins at 19:00. Rhizome lists a $20-$30 sliding-scale ticket; its authorized Pools page verifies the same range and the venue address at 6950 Maple St NW, Washington, DC. Rhizome describes Rini as a Javanese singer, educator and composer who fuses Javanese Sufi poetry with contemporary composition for Indonesian and Western instruments. Ismaily is billed as a multi-instrumentalist, composer and producer, and McGraw as a musician/ethnomusicologist and University of Richmond professor whose scholarship includes Indonesian music. The opening Alex Koi x Kirin McElwain project is explicitly described as original music for voice, cello and modular synthesizer. New Amsterdam Records documents prior studio collaboration among Rini, Ismaily and McGraw on Wulansih; Big Ears documents the same three-person billing in March 2026, and World Music Institute lists the trio together again for Jiwa Kala in February 2027. Those recurring collaborations support the event's context while also arguing against artificial scarcity for this specific date.

en.why_it_matters: This is compelling because the cultural exchange is built into the music rather than pasted onto the billing. Rini brings a Javanese vocal and compositional language shaped by Sufi poetry and traditional forms into an ongoing collaboration with Ismaily's experimental multi-instrumental vocabulary and McGraw's long engagement with Indonesian music. The opening set sharpens the same idea from another angle: voice, cello and modular synthesizer treated as one electroacoustic system. In Rhizome's small-room setting, the night has a clear Listening Notes argument about timbre, improvisation and how traditions are reorganized through collaboration.
en.trip_verdict: If Saturday is open in the DMV, this is worth the trip to Rhizome on its own and an easy date to keep visible. I would not rearrange a broader regional itinerary around it, but the small-room setting and unusually specific cross-cultural pairing make it a strong local night.

es.why_it_matters: Lo interesante es que el intercambio cultural está metido en la música y no pegado artificialmente al cartel. Rini lleva un lenguaje vocal y compositivo javanés atravesado por poesía sufí y formas tradicionales a una colaboración ya viva con el vocabulario multiinstrumental y experimental de Ismaily y la larga relación de McGraw con la música de Indonesia. El set de apertura afina la misma idea desde otro ángulo: voz, cello y sintetizador modular tratados como un solo sistema electroacústico. En el cuarto pequeño de Rhizome, la noche tiene un argumento muy Listening Notes sobre timbre, improvisación y la manera en que las tradiciones se reorganizan mediante la colaboración.
es.trip_verdict: Si el sábado está libre en el DMV, vale por sí sola la salida a Rhizome y es una fecha fácil de mantener visible. No reordenaría un itinerario regional más amplio alrededor de ella, pero el cuarto pequeño y el cruce cultural tan específico la convierten en una noche local particularmente buena.
